notes: Standard WooCommerce shop loop (54 products, 12/page = ~5 pages, 'Näytetään tulokset 1–12 / 54'). Selectors are the standard WooCommerce theme class names (li.product, .woocommerce-loop-product__title, span.price) confirmed by page content/markup patterns (add-to-cart query params, 'Lisää ostoskoriin' buttons) via fetch, but not verified against raw devtools HTML, hence medium confidence. Out-of-stock items show an overlay badge with text 'Loppu varastosta'/'Out of Stock' and their 'Lue lisää' link replaces the add-to-cart button - in_stock left null; treat presence of that badge text or the li carrying WooCommerce's 'outofstock' class as out-of-stock. Ticket 17: '/ennakkotilaukset/' is the shop's preorder category (8 products at audit time, all Pokémon — the shop sells nothing else). Its '/page/2/' serves page 1 again instead of 404ing, so a run re-reads the same products up to max_pages and logs the 'max_pages may be too low' warning; the sightings dedupe, so only the wasted fetches are real. Ticket 18: only 'Pre order' is mapped from '.acoplw-blockText' (3 on the current listing). Sold-out cards carry the longer 'Out of Stock' in the same element, which would win the longest-key match, so they are left to fall through to the WooCommerce container classes.
